regions.merged_text: HUMILITY. VIRTUES"S FOUNDATION. Soul of Christian virtues from A-Z. Practical MOTTO_ADMONITION of three words : "T-AM - THIRD God - My Neighbor - myself. Famous actor - singer - speaker ... finally ordained, prepares with great effort to "show students and brethren (in Mt. S. Pul. - Wash. ) how to preach. Everything went fine till middle of sermon when memory failed." .... Had you gone up (into pulpit), you would have come down in a way, as you went up." A well- meaning religious after all, he profited by the humiliation, a practical lesson.
